name: Besan Vegetable Cheela
steps: Whisk besan, water, turmeric, cumin, ajwain and salt until smooth; rest 5 minutes.
Stir in carrot, capsicum, onion and coriander. The batter should fall slowly from a spoon; adjust with a little water.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium. Lightly oil, pour half the batter and spread to a thin 15 cm round.
Cook 2–3 minutes until the edges lift and the base is golden. Flip and cook another 2 minutes.
Cook the second cheela. Serve with mint-coriander chutney; avoid adding sugary sauces.
note: Use a well-heated non-stick pan and spread the batter evenly for a tender centre and crisp edges.
